title: Keysa: Crack the Seed Game

prize.note: the author never published the escrow address; I found it by matching the announced amount, 369,369 sats, as a near-unique fingerprint in a full blockchain balance dump, then corroborated it by script type (v0_p2wpkh, matching BIP84) and by funding time (2 minutes 28 seconds after the announcement post)

target_format: BIP39 12 words (English), BIP84 m/84'/0'/0'/0/0, no passphrase

derivation.summary: select 12 of the 70 printed words in some order, derive the BIP84 first receiving address, and compare it to the escrow address
derivation.certified_against: the public BIP39/BIP84 test vector (mnemonic 'abandon' repeated 11 times plus 'about'), since no solved sibling exists for this puzzle
